definitions.explanation: A seasoned mixture of ground meat and other ingredients, prepared as a base or filling for dishes such as dumplings, meatballs, hamburger steaks, and stuffed vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肉|にく}だね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make the meat filling for gyoza.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}だね⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧。
examples.english: Add salt and pepper to the meat mixture and mix well.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}だね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}めて→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}けば→焼く：01123_yaku⟧、⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来上|できあ}がり→出来上がり：21122_dekiagari⟧だ。
examples.english: Form the meat mixture into patties and pan-fry them, and you've got hamburger steaks.

notes:
A cooking term composed of ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat) and だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧/たね (⟦{種|たね}→種：02157_tane⟧, meaning 'seed' or 'base material'). The たね component is written in hiragana in this compound. It refers to the raw, seasoned meat mixture before it is cooked or shaped into its final form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉|にく}だね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧: to mix the meat filling
- {肉|にく}だね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}める→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧: to roll the meat mixture into balls
- {肉|にく}だね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to wrap the meat filling (in dough or leaves)
- {肉|にく}だね⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詰|つ}める→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧: to stuff with meat filling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ひき{肉|にく}→ひき肉：17241_hikiniku⟧: ground meat — the raw ingredient, before seasoning
- ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧: filling, ingredient — broader term for any filling in dumplings, sushi, etc.
- ⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧: filling — can be sweet (bean paste) or savory; used for buns and dumplings
- タネ: base mixture — general cooking term for any prepared mixture (e.g., ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タネ for tempura batter ingredients)

USAGE:
Recipes will typically instruct you to prepare the {肉|にく}だね first by combining ⟦ひき{肉|にく}→ひき肉：17241_hikiniku⟧ with seasonings, {玉|たま}ねぎ (onion), ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (egg), and ⟦パン{粉|こ}→パン粉：04926_panko⟧ (breadcrumbs), then kneading until sticky.
